title: 建築施工
subtitle: Architectural Operation
keywords: Architectural industry 2.Construction management 3.Steel building work 4.Concrete building work
educationalGoal: Gain basic knowledge of architectural operations for safe and comfortable buildings. Understand construction techniques for various engineering works.
advice: This is a basic course in architectural materials science. We will cover the following topics: 1. Summary of architectural operations 2. Construction management 3. Execution schemes 4. Frame structure construction 5. Construction of functional aspects and finishing of buildings Students are required to prepare by reading the textbook in advance. Students are required to submit a report on their preparations. Students will observe construction work and discuss it.

Students understand the value of buildings and the ethics of architectural engineers.
